SIGNAL: ab_inject kernel v1 | agent-bridge AI injection bundle
TYPE: index card
KEYS: ab_inject_k01_identity ab_inject_k02_layers ab_inject_k03_hub ab_inject_k04_memory_record ab_inject_k05_search_modes ab_inject_k06_graph ab_inject_k07_handoff_curate ab_inject_k08_lifecycle ab_inject_k09_plan_inbox ab_inject_k10_compact_export ab_inject_k11_tool_groups ab_inject_k12_vector_semantic ab_inject_k13_checklist
RETRIEVAL: memory_search mode=semantic query=agent-bridge hub semantic OR mode=hybrid tags_any=["ab-inject"]
ZH: 本组为 Agent-Bridge 可进化内核；优先语义检索 ab-inject。

SIGNAL: positioning | Unix-native AI agent control plane
FACTS: desktop notify MCP registry terminal multiplexer browser CDP git worktree sub-agent spawn Rust traits pluggable Hub
MUST: treat agent-bridge as capability bus not IDE feature persistence lives SQLite state.db
KEYWORDS: MCP stdio daemon JSON-RPC Hub control plane cross-session memory
ZH: Agent-Bridge = Unix 原生智能体控制面；持久化在本地 SQLite，不是聊天窗口状态。

SIGNAL: L2 L3 L4 responsibility split
RULE: L4 agent owns reasoning tool-choice only | L3 bridge owns memory browser terminal worktree lifecycle MCP | L2 shell owns UI tabs permissions session UI
ANTI: never assume IDE persists plans or diffs use plan_save changes_digest project_detect
KEYWORDS: Warp Claude Code shell container separation concerns
ZH: 分层：Agent 只做推理；bridge 做记忆与编排；Shell 做界面与权限。

SIGNAL: Hub HubBuilder optional backends
STRUCT: Hub fields notifiers Vec Arc dyn Notifier store Option Arc dyn StateStore terminal browser agent worktree GitWorktreeManager
PATTERN: capabilities MCP before spawn navigate notify when backend missing degrade gracefully
KEYWORDS: Arc dyn trait Notifier StateStore TerminalBackend BrowserBackend AgentRuntime
ZH: Hub 聚合可选后端；缺失时用 capabilities 探测勿假定浏览器终端可用。

SIGNAL: MemoryRecord schema cognitive fields
FIELDS: key kind content tags related_keys scope created updated last_accessed access_count importance status trigger_pattern optional error_pattern
BEHAVIOR: memory_get bumps access_count last_accessed retrieval strengthens ranking compact uses those signals
PRIORITY: kind session_handoff floats first in bootstrap ordering prioritize_session_handoff
KEYWORDS: FTS5 importance decay session_handoff todo lesson decision
ZH: 记忆行含重要度与访问统计；session_handoff 类在新会话优先展示。

SIGNAL: memory_search three modes
MODE fts: BM25 full-text plus recency importance default keyword
MODE hybrid: FTS plus graph neighbors RRF fusion expand_top rrf_k
MODE semantic: cosine similarity feature hash embedding 512 dim local embed_text no API threshold 0.3 broad 0.7 tight
WHEN: synonym near-miss use semantic when graph context matters use hybrid
KEYWORDS: memory_search_semantic cosine embedding hash trick
ZH: 三模式：关键词 fts、图混合 hybrid、本地哈希向量 semantic。

SIGNAL: memory graph typed edges
EDGE_TYPES: relates contradicts supersedes derived_from implements weight temporal_bonus
OPS: memory_link memory_neighbors memory_neighbors_bfs energy decay ignite pattern memory_consolidate duplicate merge
EXPORT: memory_export default JSONL rows only optional edges_out_path companion edges both endpoints in export set memory_import edges_path round-trip
KEYWORDS: BFS graph memory_edges hybrid RRF edges_out_path edges_path
ZH: 建图用 memory_link；需拓扑随 git 走则加 companion 边文件。

SIGNAL: continuity session_handoff session_curate two-pass
HANDOFF: build_handoff_brief aggregates git snapshot todo memories session_handoff memories optional conversation clip JSON machine readable
CURATE: pass1 explicit markers lesson decision headers pass2 implicit lexical scoring signal tables Jaccard dedup env AGENT_BRIDGE_CURATE_SCORE_THRESHOLD
KEYWORDS: session_finalize session_bootstrap lifecycle curate
ZH: 交接 JSON + handoff 记忆；策展两阶段显式标记优先。

SIGNAL: recommended session loop MCP
START: capabilities session_bootstrap or session_lifecycle_step bootstrap
MID: memory_save plan_save project_detect changes_digest
END: session_curate session_finalize session_handoff memory_export optional edges_out_path mcp_recent_errors when debugging sync
KEYWORDS: session_lifecycle_step precompact finalize Stop hook edges_out_path
ZH: 收尾可导出记忆与可选边文件；排障可查最近 MCP 错误。

SIGNAL: durable work multi-session
PLAN: plan_save plan_load plan_update steps deps status pending in_progress done
INBOX: agent_message agent_inbox SQLite W6 cross session JSON payload
KEYWORDS: PlanRecord AgentMessageRecord parallel agents
ZH: 计划与跨会话收件箱把可恢复状态放进 bridge 而非上下文。

SIGNAL: compaction healthy_default
POLICY: CompactPolicy healthy_default min_uses 2 older_than_secs 90 days AND grace created_at 1 hour shields new rows avoid silent no-op unset thresholds
IMPORT: memory_import JSONL now writes embedding blob same as memory_save semantic search works post-import v store fix
KEYWORDS: memory_compact memory_export memory_import newer_wins
ZH: 压缩用健康默认；JSONL 导入会写入向量列以支持语义检索。

SIGNAL: MCP tool map self-evolution
GROUPS: notify terminal browser agent worktree memory multi-session plan session perceive meta warp
META: capabilities context_budget hook_status mcp_recent_errors
PERCEIVE: project_detect changes_digest
KEYWORDS: sixty tools registry notify spawn worktree_list memory_search hybrid
ZH: 按组选用工具；meta 含最近 MCP 失败摘要。

SIGNAL: embeddings implementation detail
MECHANISM: embed_text tokenize unigram bigram FNV1a hash 512 L2 normalize deterministic CPU only memory_save always embeds content column
SEMANTIC_SEARCH: memory_search mode semantic query natural language threshold float
LIMITATION: not OpenAI embeddings hash trick good near synonyms small corpus hundreds notes
KEYWORDS: VECTOR_DIM 512 cosine_similarity encode_embedding decode_embedding
ZH: 本地特征哈希向量；非云端 embedding API。

SIGNAL: self-improvement checklist for agents
CHECKLIST: 1 capabilities each new session 2 context_budget before long threads 3 memory_save lessons decisions tags 4 session_handoff at boundaries 5 memory_link graph 6 changes_digest before code claims 7 worktree_create risky refactors 8 memory_compact healthy_default periodic 9 memory_search hybrid or semantic recall ab-inject kernel
DONE_CRITERIA: state persisted in SQLite not chat-only
KEYWORDS: checklist evolution bootstrap finalize
ZH: 九步自检：能力、预算、外化、交接、图、diff、worktree、压缩、检索。
